inputs.note: births/deaths from min_cluster_size_barcode_seed45. For each case: clusters_a = indices i where births[i]<=birth_a AND deaths[i]>birth_a (half-open interval, matching compute_total_persistence's left-open/right-closed (birth, death] convention read backwards); same for clusters_b with birth_b. Result = jaccard_similarity(clusters_a, clusters_b) -- same birth_a/birth_b (2nd case) is NOT guaranteed to give similarity 1.0 in general (only if clusters_a's construction is deterministic given identical inputs, which it is here since both loops use the same arrays) so this case should come out as exactly 1.0.
